warning.titlePre: Jaguar XKR Timing Chain Tensioner Wear
paragraphs: If your XKR is a 1996–2006 model with the AJ34 supercharged 4.0-litre V8 — that's the X100 generation — timing chain tensioner wear is a well-established pattern on these Nikasil-liner-era engines, confirmed in Jaguar specialist circles. We replace the timing chain, tensioners and guides as standard on every AJ34 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established pattern in Jaguar specialist circles, per VRF-jaguar-xk.md. Confirmed specifically for the X100 generation.
